title: Induction principle for quasi-compact opens
statement: Let X be a quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme] quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let P be a property of its quasi-compact open subschemes. If P holds for every affine open and whenever U is quasi-compact open and V is affine open, P holds for U, V, and U intersect V implies P holds for U union V, then P holds for every quasi-compact open of X, in particular X.
